# Hokuyo LIDAR USB Driver

Since this driver is unsigned, Windows will not allow you to install it unless you turn off digital signature checking. This is a risky procedure, so ensure you turn it back on after you've installed this driver.

## Disabling Digital Signature Checking

1. In the Start Menu, search for "Advanced Startup" and click on the System Settings link.
2. Click "Restart Now".
3. After your PC restarts, navigate to "Advanced Options" (this may be under another menu, like "Fix my PC") and then "Startup Settings".
4. Use your keyboard to select "Disable Driver Signature Enforcement".
5. After your computer reboots, install the driver by right-clicking `URG_USB_Driver.inf` and selecting "Install".
6. Once you're done, simply restart your PC to re-enable digital signature checking.
